summary: Ashland Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its receivables purchase agreement, a routine credit facility modification. The Fifth Amendment reduces commitments to $70 million and extends the termination date to July 28, 2028, with other market-standard updates. This is an ordinary financing arrangement, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No strategic event, activist involvement, or capital return is indicated. The filing merely updates an existing securitization facility, so it does not meet the criteria for a special-situations category.
